title: March of the Machine | Episode 4: Beneath Eyes Unblinking

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker and elf of Skemfar who returns to Kaldheim to lead the defense and leaps into the jaws of a Phyrexian serpent.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: Tyvar's brother, who rallies the realms of Kaldheim onto longships.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, a leader in Ghirapur who prepares the city against the invasion.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker and genius of Kaladesh who warned Pia and built Operation Golden Scales.

entities.name: Baji
entities.description: A former renegade contact who offers Pia his skimmer and is killed by a Phyrexian quill.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian angel leading the invasion of New Capenna, who hates the beauty she cannot stop thinking about.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Pia's daughter, a planeswalker whose whereabouts worry Pia.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whose orders are to harvest New Capenna.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The serpent whose shadow elves of Kaldheim grew up in.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: Plane of the realms around the World Tree, now invaded.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The elven realm of Kaldheim.

entities.name: The World Tree
entities.description: The tree of Kaldheim being strangled by a Phyrexian serpent.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane of aether and invention under attack.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The Kaladeshi city that holds the aetherflux reservoir and is evacuated and defended.

entities.name: Aetherflux reservoir
entities.description: Ghirapur's aether store that the Phyrexians head straight for.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A towering city plane scoured by Atraxa's forces.

entities.name: Museum
entities.description: A marble building on New Capenna that Atraxa destroys.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane of the swampy safe house.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane of the invaders.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Phyrexian World Tree whose branches descend onto Kaldheim and Kaladesh.

entities.name: Operation Golden Scales
entities.description: Saheeli's defensive plan deploying bronze attack lizards across Ghirapur.

entities.name: The Cosmos
entities.description: The light of Kaldheim that reinforces the elves, opening a doomskar and carrying fleets.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A New Capenna family whose members have been compleated and whose minds Atraxa searches.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde invading every plane.

entities.name: The renegades
entities.description: Kaladeshi rebels, now allies.

events.summary: Tyvar returns to Skemfar to find it under Phyrexian attack, with a serpent strangling the World Tree and pods raining down.
events.quote: he knows he is too late

events.summary: Tyvar tells his brother Harald that the enemies are Phyrexians who will oil and transform the elves, and that Kaldheim cannot be saved by elves alone.
events.quote: This isn't an enemy the elves can vanquish alone.

events.summary: The Cosmos opens a doomskar, swallowing Phyrexians and elves, and Tyvar shapes a rock platform amid the water.
events.quote: torrents of water emerge

events.summary: Longships of all Kaldheim's peoples arrive and Harald rallies the elves to join them.
events.quote: The elves will lead it!

events.summary: Tyvar and Harald board a longship, and Harald addresses the united warriors with an oath of old grudges.
events.quote: Our grudges are ancient.

events.summary: The fleet passes through the Cosmos and flies toward the Invasion Tree with valkyries.
events.quote: Valkyries fly alongside them toward the sharp barbs of the Invasion Tree

events.summary: A Phyrexian serpent rises from the sea, snapping longships, and Tyvar leaps into its mouth.
events.quote: Tyvar leaps from the ship.

events.summary: Pia recalls Saheeli's warning of an invasion and the Phyrexian eye symbol appearing everywhere.
events.quote: We have to be ready for an invasion,

events.summary: Pia and Saheeli address the consulate and prepare Ghirapur, evacuating citizens and arming skyships.
events.quote: If Pia allocated the resources to fight, then fight they would.

events.summary: The portals open and the invasion spines descend onto Kaladesh.
events.quote: the great spines of invasion descended from the holes they tore in reality

events.summary: A branch wraps around Ghirapur's flagship and destroys it.
events.quote: She watches as the branch wraps around the ship

events.summary: Saheeli's Operation Golden Scales deploys bronze lizards that clash with Phyrexian soldiers, and she rescues Pia.
events.quote: Deployment chambers spring up from hatches all along the street

events.summary: Saheeli and Pia race to the reservoir, noting the Phyrexians are heading there and that converted guards cannot yet be saved.
events.quote: We can't do anything to save them,

events.summary: Saheeli evades telling Pia what happened to Chandra.
events.quote: Pia's been around politicians long enough to know when she isn't getting the whole story.

events.summary: Baji offers his skimmer and Pia boards it, but a Phyrexian quill kills him and the skimmer plummets with Pia at the controls.
events.quote: a javelin punches through the window and impales him through the chest to his seat

events.summary: Atraxa begins scouring New Capenna, destroying its inhabitants with swarms and gas.
events.quote: A single thought from Atraxa summons swarms of flying servitors.

events.summary: Atraxa searches the minds of compleated Maestros and learns the word beautiful and museum.
events.quote: Searching their minds provides another answer: museum .

events.summary: Atraxa destroys the museum and its art, enraged at the idea of beauty.
events.quote: she obliterates everything within it

events.summary: Atraxa beheads stone angel statues outside the cathedral despite the pain of Halo.
events.quote: In a blur of white, she strikes the heads from the statues.

events.summary: The angel statues, with an unseen visitor, choose not to stop Atraxa, saying it is not yet time.
events.quote: It is not yet time.

relations.quote: Tyvar sees his brother fighting alongside his people
and not when it comes to her daughter.
She and Saheeli addressed the consulate

relations.note: follows her orders to harvest New Capenna

relations.quote: one of her old renegade contacts, Baji

relations.note: have compleated some of the Maestros, who now serve the invasion
